verdict.rationale: Customer risk scoring is a fair axis for an AML/compliance platform, so this applies. The evidence only shows that users can configure the risk-score equation and choose screening configurations. Nothing documents feeding custom signals such as device fingerprints, behavioral data or arbitrary metadata into the scoring model, so this is an adjacent control, not the story's capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can feed the model my own signals — device fingerprints, behavioral data, custom metadata — so scoring reflects my business, not just network defaults
